clues.text: This city sits in the valleys of three rivers, in a desert on the central coast of its land. It looks out over the Pacific Ocean.
clues.narrowing: Puts the player on a desert coast by the Pacific, in three river valleys.

source.quote: located in the valleys of the Chillón, Rímac and Lurín Rivers, in the desert zone of the central coastal part of the country, overlooking the Pacific Ocean.

clues.text: This desert city stays mild, though it lies in the hot tropics. Cold sea water close by cools the air, and rain is very rare here.
clues.narrowing: Rules out hot deserts and wet tropics; keeps a mild desert cooled by a cold sea.

source.quote: Lima has a mild climate, despite its location in the tropics and in a desert

clues.text: A Spanish captain picked this river valley for his new capital and founded the city in 1535. It soon ruled a vast realm for Spain.
clues.narrowing: Shrinks the list to capitals a Spanish captain founded in a river valley in 1535.

source.quote: Pizarro decided to found the capital in the Rímac river valley

clues.text: This city was founded in 1535 with a grand name: City of the Kings. The name marked a feast day in early January, when the city was founded.
clues.narrowing: Nearly decisive: one capital was founded as the City of the Kings.

source.quote: Lima was founded with the name "City of the Kings", named in this way in honor of the Epiphany

clues.text: This city is the political and trade heart of Peru. The Government Palace, first built by its founder, stands here still.
clues.narrowing: Confirms it: Peru's political heart, with the Government Palace.

source.quote: The city is considered the political, cultural, financial and commercial center of Peru.

reveal.blurb: Spanish men under Pizarro founded this city in 1535 and named it City of the Kings. It became the capital of a vast Spanish realm, then kept the job when the land won its freedom. Today it is a huge desert city by the cold Pacific, mild all year. Lima is the capital of Peru.
